description: A threat intelligence program for gathering and analyzing threat data is not established. This signal indicates that emerging threats may not be identified or addressed proactively.
applicability: Applicable to Level 3 environments requiring threat awareness. Includes threat intelligence feeds, intelligence analysis, and threat information sharing.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through threat intel program review, feed integration verification, and intelligence utilization assessment.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
